result.summary: RESULT. WF-02 step 2b is done for REQ-001 (page) and REQ-007 (office), built to design docs/design/REQ-001-pixel-office.md v2r3 (sha256 49eba7c95a905b21... unchanged by me). Twelve new files in tools/src/pixel-office/public/ (texts, format, model, layout, office-model, office-sim, office-view, app, boot, office-report .js; index.html; style.css) plus exactly ONE block in tools/eslint.config.js ({files: ["src/pixel-office/public/**/*.js"], languageOptions: {globals: {...globals.browser}}}). Nothing was redesigned and no test was written. Order of design 14 followed: step 4 (format, texts, model), step 5 (layout, office-model, office-sim, office-view), step 6 (app, boot, index.html, style.css, eslint block; app.js written after every module it imports), step 7 (office-report); each step ended with clean prettier and eslint on my files. No defect blocks. 10 items are in result.issues (I0-I9); I1 (requestAnimationFrame does not fire in the U3 recipe) and I5 (DOM details left to me) matter most to TEST-DESIGNER and UAT-RUNNER. MAPPING REQ-001 (page parts) -> code - AC2 time (hook's moment, UTC in the file, owner's clock on the page): the page never computes or shifts a time; format.js fmtTime / fmtTimeSec / fmtDateTime / tzLabel (zone read from Intl at every call; an unreadable time gives an empty string). Tasks show fmtTime, journal rows fmtTimeSec, server starts fmtDateTime, zone in #tz-label. Checked under TZ=Asia/Almaty: 04:00Z shows "09:00", label "Asia/Almaty". - AC3 only needed fields on the page: app.js applyAnswer passes every element of an answer through schema.parseLine (foreign key or unknown kind -> null, kept in entries); model.js journalRow copies only the fields of 3.5. - AC4 REAL/SIMULATION and the reading rule: model.js readRule(entries, nowMs) with rule (a) source not REAL, (b) conflicts (one-pass fast path; Fenwick-tree degrees and a candidate loop; tie goes to the later line), (c) last line "future"; buildModel gives marks, trusted and journal rows (marked, reason). Header mark: texts.HEADER_BADGE set by app.js decorate(). Marked rows are shown with their source and NOT_FROM_HOOKS (app.js journalItem) and take part in nothing (tasks, sessions, main rows, office, card). - AC5 one stream: app.js keeps ONE entries array (changed in place); rebuild() builds model and office once and renderAll() draws journal, list, legend, card and the office from them; getModel().entries is that array. - AC6 tasks (а)-(з): model.js buildModel. (а) repeated start: same task, resumed_at; (б) stop without start: no task, the row stays in the journal; (в) state "unrecorded" by server start (journal_lines > index of the last start; stale records with journal_lines > number of lines are dropped, E33) or by SessionEnd of the session of the LAST start; after a resume (SessionEnd, SessionStart, start) the task is in progress; (г) row of the main session: MainRow with closed_by stop / next_prompt / session_end / server_start, a late Stop returns a server_start row to "completed" (the 11 cases of PG-12d6 checked); (д) list order: in progress first, new on top; (е) time and zone; (ж) empty journal: app.js renderEmpty (EMPTY_JOURNAL and EMPTY_HINT); (з) description only through linkOf: PostToolUse with launched_agent_id equal to the key, duplicates of tool_use_id collapsed, exactly one left, else description, subagent_type and launched_by are null. Time of every server start: app.js renderStarts. Beside "in progress": started and last-event spans (app.js taskItem), and an extra ended span for completed tasks (the requirement lists the end as a field of a task). - AC7 one command / live: app.js createApp: start(), poll() / requestCycle() / getJson(), onTick(), onVisibility(), setConnected(). Interval POLL_MS 2 s; one request in flight; own timer of POLL_TIMEOUT_MS 3 s around the whole request (also works if the fetch ignores abort; the first load has the same limit); after = entries.length; an answer is applied only if from is 0 (array replaced) or entries.length (appended), otherwise discarded with one immediate retry and the second misfit is a failure; shape check (app is "sai-pixel-office", whole numbers, arrays); failure shows NO_CONNECTION and keeps what is loaded; first good answer hides it and the cursor loads what was missed; poll at once on visibilitychange to visible; model rebuilt on change and at least every 10 s. - AC8/AC9 page only reads, nothing external: getJson is the only network function (GET, relative /api/events); all journal text goes in through textContent (the markup helpers never use any HTML-string API); index.html has one

issues.severity: MEDIUM (a fact of the real browser that the design's step U3 does not know; fixed in code, design text and OF-21 need one sentence)
issues.title: requestAnimationFrame does not fire in the headless --dump-dom recipe of step U3, so a page that draws only in frames fails U3 condition 4
issues.detail: Probe (scratchpad/fe/raf/probe.mjs, Chrome 154.0.8037.59, flags of 10.4: --headless=new --disable-gpu --virtual-time-budget=6000 --dump-dom): a page with a requestAnimationFrame loop and a 2 s setInterval printed 'raf=0 interval2s=3 elapsed=6000 vis=visible': timers run, frames do not. My first build drew the office only inside animation frames: the dump showed <canvas id="office" ... data-drawn="0"> (one frame ran before the data came), so condition 4 (data-drawn with a number of 1 or more) failed on a healthy page although the screenshot run, which forces frames, showed the office. Design 4.5 and 4.7 do not say when drawOffice runs; the stand-in pages of probe P17 evidently did not depend on frames. Fix in app.js: onTick() calls drawOnce() when the model was rebuilt (modelVersion) and no frame has drawn it yet (drawnVersion), so the office on screen matches the journal within one poll period also in a hidden tab or a browser that gives no frames; in a normal visible tab frames draw first and the tick does nothing. After the fix: conditions 1-5 of U3 all ok, data-drawn="5" (scratchpad/fe/e2e.sh).
issues.proposal: Design: add one sentence to 4.5/4.7 ('the office is also drawn at the poll tick if no frame drew the current model'). TEST-DESIGNER OF-21: data-drawn is absent until the first completed drawOffice, which happens in a frame or at the first tick (clock advanced by POLL_MS) after a model change; with a throwing ctx the tick tries again every period and console.error stays at one line per message. UAT-RUNNER: U3 is a valid check of this page only because of this tick.

issues.detail: 2.3 gives positions as {key, x, y, state, route, queued} and hitTest(positions, px, py) takes only positions. A test that deep-compares a whole positions() entry would see the extra key.

issues.severity: INFO (for TEST-DESIGNER: choices where 4.7 leaves room; none contradicts the design)
issues.title: DOM and API details to read before writing PG-12, PG-23, OF-10, OF-15, OF-18, OF-20 and OF-21
issues.detail: Tasks (#tasks > li, data-kind, data-key, data-state): spans in order role, desc, state, started (fmtTime), last-event (in progress only; for a row of the main session it is taken from its session), ended (extra, completed only, fmtTime of ended_at), session (first 8 code points). desc is present for tasks (empty text when there is no description) and absent for a row of the main session. data-label on started / last-event / ended holds a caption that CSS shows before the time (texts LABEL_STARTED, LABEL_LAST_EVENT, LABEL_ENDED, extra to the table of 4.7). Journal (#journal > li, data-index, data-marked 'true' or 'false'): spans time, event (EVENT_LABELS), role, desc, session, source, mark (always present; text NOT_FROM_HOOKS only when marked); newest first, the last 200 non-empty lines; SHOWN_NOTE gets n = 200 and N = number of non-empty lines; the list shows 300 items. #empty holds one text 'EMPTY_JOURNAL newline EMPTY_HINT'. #connection: NO_CONNECTION and hidden false when there is no connection, empty text and hidden true otherwise. #server-starts: one li per record in file order (CSS shows the newest at the bottom of a column-reverse list). #legend li.legend-item[data-role] with role, count, desk. #card as 4.7 with the title = full; for the main session card-working holds CARD_SESSIONS plus the number of running sessions only. Data attributes are written with both setAttribute and dataset. The page uses only createElement, textContent, appendChild, replaceChildren, classList.add, dataset, setAttribute, hidden, addEventListener (document and canvas), getElementById, visibilityState, getBoundingClientRect, getContext, and on the context fillRect, fillText and the properties fillStyle, font, textAlign: the fakes of 10.1 are enough. createApp: start() looks the elements up, registers the interval and the visibility listener, asks for the first frame and then polls; poll() resolves at once if a request is in flight (it does not hand back the in-flight promise, so awaiting it cannot deadlock on a hanging fetch); the interval callback returns undefined; a response counts as good if status is 200 (or, when the fake has no status, ok is true); every request is fetchFn(url, {method: 'GET', signal}). Sim: routes start at the first tick after enqueue, not at enqueue; positions() state 'waiting' means the walker sits and the head of its queue waits for `after`; route is the id of the current route; queued counts the waiting routes without the current one; enqueue sorts a copy by event_index (handoff before result). drawOffice draws a badge for a count above 1 with fillRect and one more fillText (centred, same maxWidth), so a test that counts fillText calls must expect labels plus badges. Model.serverStarts is the array as sent; only the rules drop records with journal_lines above the number of lines.
issues.needs: TEST-DESIGNER: use these as the contract of the DOM layer; if a reading is wrong, FRONTEND-DEV changes the code, not the design.

issues.title: Card of the main session: 4.7 says card-working holds 'CARD_WORKING and the number (for the main session CARD_SESSIONS and the number of running sessions)'
issues.detail: Read as a replacement, not an addition: the main card shows 'идущих сессий: N' only; its working_count is not shown on the card (it is in the office model and in the list of tasks). Both texts would be a one-line change.

issues.detail: roles come from the legend, so a role without a desk is listed with desk_index null; with --session the counts, working and the routes are limited to the tasks whose session_id (the session of the LAST start, 3.5) equals the id, while desk_index and cells are the same as on the page (the office is built from the whole journal); main.working with --session means an open row of that session; a key given twice, an empty --journal value and any other word are usage errors (exit 2, the design lists only the four cases of E30a); an incomplete last line without a newline is not a line, as on the server. issues.title: The legend is not capped
issues.detail: The design caps the journal at 200 and the list at 300 but not the legend (requirement REQ-007 AC1 wants every role with a task in the legend). A journal with thousands of different agent_type values would give thousands of legend items. Real roles are the files of .claude/agents plus a few built-in types (about 30), so I did not add a cap that the requirement does not allow.
